The '''Children of the Tempest''' were a band of mutant [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who resided on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan]].

==History==
During the [[Jedi Civil War]], the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Dying Sun]]'' crashed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan]] in the [[Luire system]], stranding the surviving [[Human/Legends|Human]] crew on the world. The ship's [[Commander/Legends|commander]], [[Darth Glovoc]], was subsequently placed into [[Suspended animation/Legends|suspended animation]] and over time, the survivors' descendants developed into a group twisted and inbred subhumans known as the Children of the Tempest. The deformed Sith howled like beasts and hunted with [[Spear/Legends|spears]], and they revered Glovoc as a sleeping [[God/Legends|deity]]. They established an altar in the [[Steamfields]], a geologically active region of Nyriaan, and they remained in relative seclusion and were were hostile to native [[Nyriaanan]]s, whom they occasionally encountered.

The rogue [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Spy/Legends|intelligence agent]] [[Yrssk]] developed an understanding with the Children of the Tempest, after he plied them with trinkets and sacrificial victims. After group of Republic operatives journeyed to Nyriaan to track down Yrssk, he persuaded several of the mutant Sith to help him ambush the agents in the Steamfields, and the Sith were subsequently defeated.

In [[132 ABY]], the Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Darth Vurik]] traveled to Nyriaan seeking to gain custody of Glovoc, and many of the Children of the Tempest perished while in combat with him. After Vurik was distracted by a group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], the deformed Sith moved the slumbering Glovoc to a hidden location, out of Vurik's grasp.
